entries.en: He's easin' into it, slowly. Needs a day or two to get up on his feet.
entries.ro: Se adaptează încet. Îi trebuie o zi-două ca să se pună pe picioare.

entries.en: You have my thanks, V. On behalf of myself and the entire family.
entries.ro: Îți mulțumesc, V. Și eu, și toată familia.

entries.en: Sadly... I don't have any good news. The implant didn't take.
entries.ro: Din păcate... nu am vești bune. Implantul n-a prins.

entries.en: No. Maybe it was just an accident... maybe it wasn't. Too late to tell.
entries.ro: Nu. Poate a fost doar un accident... sau poate nu. Acum nu mai contează.

entries.en: [Set down] I've got the implant... but it's infected.
entries.ro: [Pune jos] Am implantul... dar e infectat.

entries.en: Come by in a few hours. Things should settle down by then.
entries.ro: Revino peste câteva ore. Până atunci ar trebui să se liniștească lucrurile.

entries.en: Got Jake's implant, but there's a virus on it. You'll have to swap out its firmware with the original on the shard.
entries.en_m: I got Jake's implant, but there's a virus on it. You'll have to swap out its firmware with the original on the shard.
entries.ro: Am implantul lui Jake, dar are un virus. Trebuie să-i schimbi firmware-ul cu cel original de pe shard.

entries.en: Just on time, V. Just on time.
Hmph. What a surprise. Nomads always get special treatment.
entries.ro: Mda. Ce surpriză. Nomazii primesc mereu tratament special.
Mulțumesc că ai fost atentă, V.
entries.ro_m: Mulțumesc că ai fost atent, V.

entries.en: You did everything you could, V. We'll never forget that.
entries.ro: Ai făcut tot ce ai putut, V. Nu o să uităm niciodată.
